title: Algorithm Definition
description: Schema for an algorithm definition YAML file, which specifies meta information and one or more statistical models.

models.description: Map of model entries. Keys are arbitrary model identifiers. The special key '_all_' defines shared configuration that is merged into every other model (without overwriting values already set on the model).

_all_.description: Shared configuration applied to all models. Values here are copied to each named model unless that model already defines them.

predictor_allowable_values.description: Map of predictor variable names to their allowable input values. Each value is either a string expression (e.g. 'seq(13, 49, by = 0.01)' or '1:10') or an explicit array of numbers.

oneOf.description: An R-style range or seq() expression defining allowable values.
An explicit list of allowable numeric values.

reference_group.description: Map of predictor variable names to their reference (baseline) values used when computing model outputs.

additionalProperties.description: Reference value for this predictor variable.

shared_model_config.description: Configuration fields that can appear on an individual model or in the '_all_' shared block.

model_entry.description: A named model within the algorithm. Defines the display title, the path to the model export CSV, and optional predictor configuration.

title.description: Human-readable display name for this model.

model_export.description: Relative path (from this YAML file's directory) to the model export CSV file.

model_color.description: Optional hex color used when displaying this model. If omitted, a color is assigned automatically from the viridis palette.
